node.title: Re: Why does default $_ only work
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
As [LanX] [id://11120552|said], you haven't really given enough information to go on. Please see [id://174051], [id://510718], and [id://1177642].

My guess would be that it has something to do with $_ = (/(.)\1/), since that doesn't entirely make sense to me. It's the equivalent of $_ = ($_ =~ /(.)\1/), that is, you're matching the regular expression against [doc://$_] and then assigning the return value of the match back to [doc://$_]. Similarly, if you wrote $selection = (/(.)\1/), then that is implicitly matching the regular expression against $_ and assigning the return value of the match to $selection. You probably meant to write $selection =~ /(.)\1/ instead.
